description.zh: 待删除的加速域名，仅支持删除单个域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name that you want to delete. You can delete only one domain name at a time.

descriptions.zh:
> - 删除域名前您需前往域名解析服务商恢复域名A记录，否则域名被删除后可能导致该域名不可访问。
> - **DeleteDcdnDomain**调用成功后将删除对应加速域名的全部相关记录，如果您想暂停使用该加速域名，您可以调用[StopDcdnDomain](~~130622~~)接口。
> - 单用户调用频率：10次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - Before you delete a domain name, contact your domain name resolution service provider to restore the A record of the domain name. If you do not restore the A record, the domain name may become inaccessible after it is deleted.
>
> - After you call the **DeleteDcdnDomain** operation, all records that are associated with the accelerated domain name are deleted. If you want to pause the accelerated domain name instead of deleting it, call the [StopDcdnDomain](~~130622~~) operation.
>
> - A single user can make up to 10 calls per second.
